visual_goal: Show the agent on the same command path as a person: reads through product APIs, writes proposals, and reaches the binding offer command only via the principal's approval or the envelope service, with everything in one decision log.
prompt: A left-to-right flow illustration. Far left: a stream of small listing cards labeled 'Listing events', one arrow into a rounded assistant box with a small chat-bubble icon labeled 'Agent runtime'. Above the runtime a cloud box labeled 'Model gateway' with one arrow from the runtime labeled 'prompt'. From the runtime three arrows to the right: an upper arrow labeled 'read' into a box with a row of five small gates labeled 'Product APIs'; a middle arrow labeled 'propose' into a tray box labeled 'Proposal store', which has one arrow into an inbox with a person icon labeled 'Approval inbox'; a lower arrow labeled 'commit' into a box drawn as a sealed envelope labeled 'Envelope service'. Exactly two arrows enter 'Offer command': one from 'Approval inbox' labeled 'approve' and one from 'Envelope service'; 'Envelope service' has only that one outgoing arrow, into a stamped command box labeled 'Offer command'. One arrow from 'Offer command' up to 'Product APIs'. At the bottom a long ledger book labeled 'Decision log' with exactly two arrows in: one long arrow down from 'Proposal store' and one from 'Offer command'. These are the only words in the image.
alt: Listing events reach the agent runtime, which prompts the model gateway, reads through product APIs, writes proposals to an approval inbox, or commits through the envelope service; only approval or the envelope reach the offer command, and everything lands in the decision log.

visual_goal: Show a buying proposal end to end: the agent gets the listing with its tier, values it, proposes; the buyer approves a lower offer; the command re-checks segment status and value drift before opening the offer.
prompt: A left-to-right swimlane illustration with six vertical lanes, each headed by a small icon and a label: a trading board labeled 'Tradefloor', an assistant box labeled 'Agent runtime', a gauge dial labeled 'Vantage', a tray labeled 'Proposal store', a generic professional at a desk labeled 'Velto buyer', and a stamp labeled 'Offer command'. Horizontal arrows from top to bottom: from 'Tradefloor' to 'Agent runtime' labeled 'listing 10:00'; from 'Agent runtime' to 'Vantage' labeled 'valuation'; from 'Agent runtime' to 'Proposal store' labeled 'offer €13,650'; from 'Proposal store' to 'Velto buyer' labeled 'inbox'; from 'Velto buyer' back to 'Proposal store' labeled 'approve €13,400'; from 'Proposal store' to 'Offer command' labeled 'approval id'; from 'Offer command' to 'Vantage' labeled 're-check'; a final arrow pointing left, starting at 'Offer command' with its arrowhead at 'Velto buyer', labeled 'offer open'. These are the only words in the image.
alt: Swimlanes: Tradefloor releases a listing at 10:00 to the agent, which gets a valuation from Vantage and proposes an offer of €13,650; the Velto buyer approves €13,400; the offer command re-checks Vantage and opens the offer.
